build_build_api_docs: build API docs for tensorflow_datasets by running the script with output_dir and code_url_prefix flags
build_execute_docs: build tensorflow_datasets API documentation using execute function with custom output_dir, code_url_prefix, search_hints, and site_path parameters
run_build_api_docs: run the build_api_docs script via app.run(main) to generate tfds API documentation from command-line flags
build_doc_generator: build a DocGenerator instance with root_title, py_modules, base_dir, search_hints, code_url_prefix, and site_path to generate tfds API docs
build_doc_generator_output: build and output generated API documentation to a specified directory using doc_generator.build(output_dir)
